$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors

formatVersion.description: Version of the zones.json format the file follows

zones.description: Every DNS zone the fleet owns

location.description: What a redirect's Location must start with

allowCountries.description: The only countries allowed on countryHosts, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes

countryHosts.description: Labels under the zone that allowCountries applies to, such as app and auth

botFightModeOff.description: Turn Bot Fight Mode off, which challenges visitors with a script

wwwRedirect.description: Redirect www to the apex, 301, keeping the path and query

rateLimit.description: A limit on requests to one path per client address, such as a sign-in endpoint

noCachePrefixes.description: Path prefixes never cached, such as /api/, besides / and .html documents

path.description: The exact request path limited, such as /login-token

requests.description: Requests one address may make in 10 seconds; default 5

whenRecord.description: A record label that must be present before the limit applies, such as auth

name.description: The label under the zone, or @ for the zone itself

values.description: The values; for a proxied record, the origin, which only Cloudflare sees; an MX value is the priority and host

proxied.description: Whether Cloudflare proxies the record and answers with its own addresses

source.description: Where what it serves comes from: a static site's repository or the fleet's app/stack

host.description: What serves it, such as github-pages or the fleet host's name

status.description: Whether it should exist now; planned records are skipped by verify

check.description: An HTTPS request to the host that must answer as given

notes.description: Anything else to know about the record

records.description: Every record of the zone, one entry per name and type

hardening.description: The zone's settings for the security baseline deployforge zones harden applies

notes.description: What a reader changing the zone must know

title: DNS zones
description: Every DNS zone the fleet owns, each record and what it serves.
